purpose: Resolve the temporal branch of the rent-review pathway without confusing enactment, commencement, tenancy generation or review date.
composition_rules: Do not infer legal effect from Act publication date alone.
Check commencement where a statutory provision is relied upon.
Preserve historical treatment when the relevant event occurred under an earlier regime.
If dates are invalid, missing or ambiguous, return FACT_REQUIRED.
important_distinction: A tenancy created before 1 March 2026 and a rent review occurring after 1 March 2026 are separate temporal facts. The engine must not collapse them into a single date test.
verification_note: Temporal classification is structural until every dependent statutory provision, commencement provision and exception has been provision-level verified.
